summary: Iteration 8: tested the 'Add sump / pump' feature for the drain tile layout, backend and frontend. Backend: new file test_iter8_sumps.py (18 tests) and iter7 regression (13 tests), 31/31 pass. Covered saving sumps with clamping and rounding; main sump type/HP/pit fields; a body without sumps leaving them unchanged; sumps [] clearing them; bad type, bad lengths, outlet shape and NaN/Infinity returning 422/400 with no change saved; reset giving sumps [] and edited false; PNG showing red squares, a white dot for pump types and green discharge lines; crew PDF showing extra sumps. UI at 1920 wide: the header 'Add sump / pump' button enters edit mode with SP-2 selected and the form showing; the field edits update the tab live; dragging drain-xsump-0 and drain-xoutlet-0 works; drain-add-sump adds SP-3; sump-toggle-outlet adds and removes the discharge line; the main tab has no remove or toggle buttons; tapping a sump on the sheet selects its tab; save shows the FIELD-ADJUSTED badge and the tabs stay read-only after reload; cancel discards a removal; remove + save persists; 'AI layout' reset removes the added sumps; PNG download works (drain_tile_S-201.png). The 390px mobile layout of sump-panel/sump-form is a clean 2-column grid with no horizontal overflow. TEST_Iter4 page 2 was reset at the end. Smith Residence was not touched.

minor.issue: Sending only {sump:{x,y}} (no type/pump_hp/pit_size/notes) silently clears the main sump's saved type/HP/pit/notes, because sump_fields always writes SumpPt defaults. The frontend always sends every field, so it is only an API-semantics risk. Consider model_fields_set to update only the fields that were sent.
SumpPt.label/Pt.label has no max_length: a 500-char label returned 200, while the frontend limits it to 30. The sumps list length is also unbounded.
merge() only sets label when it is non-empty, so the main sump's label cannot be cleared (the old label is kept).

design_issues.screen: Drainage > Drain tile layout edit mode
issues: Every new sump spawns at the same fixed spot (480,480, outlet 560,420), so adding two in a row stacks them exactly on top of each other. Offset each new sump.
The edit-bar 'Remove' button only removes cleanouts (disabled when a sump is selected). Its generic label is ambiguous now that sumps exist; consider 'Remove cleanout'.
The sump-remove trash icon button has no aria-label/title.
In read mode the sump-tab-* buttons are clickable but do nothing (no-op cursor/hover).

action_items: Optional: in edit_drain, apply the main-sump type/pump_hp/pit_size/notes only when they are in body.sump.model_fields_set
Optional: add max_length to Pt.label (e.g. 60) and a max_length for the sumps list
Optional: offset newSump() defaults so repeated adds don't overlap
